items.h: Makes all six kicks in MNF victory
items.s: Aubrey made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PAT tries in Monday's 38-21 win over the Eagles. Aubrey benefited from a bounce-back performance out of Dallas' offense, as he had been limited to one field-goal attempt and two PATs over the previous two games combined. Monday marked the third time Aubrey made three field goals in a game this season, as he connected from 55, 27 and 24 yards. Aubrey's likely to remain busy in Week 8 against the Cardinals, who are giving up a league-high 29.7 points per game.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey scores 12 points in win Monday
items.s: Brandon Aubrey went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Aubrey had a perfect showing on Monday night, making all six of his kicks in a win over the Eagles. He is one of the NFL's best kickers and should continue to produce like it moving forward.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Fringe Starting Option In Fantasy Football In Week 7
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey's fantasy value has plummeted this season, and even more so when you compare it to previous seasons he had. The former No. 1 kicker in fantasy football sits outside the top-20 scorers at his position this season thanks to a Dallas offense that's regressed substantially since last year. He also has missed a whopping 25 percent of his field goal attempts and whiffed on one of his 15 extra point tries. His 75 percent field goal accuracy ranks near the bottom of the league, and his 12 total attempts is a middling number even when not accounting for some kickers missing a game due to bye weeks. We may see him have more luck against the Philadelphia Eagles in…

Aubrey did not attempt any field goals but converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 23-13 loss at Green Bay. In a game where the Cowboys fell into a hole early and turned the ball over three times in opposing territory, Aubrey was mostly a spectator, failing to make at least one field goal in a game for the first time since Week 1 against the Giants. Dallas' offense will have better days than it did Sunday, and one of those could come in Week 7 against a Philadelphia defense that has looked poor at times this season.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey held to one XP in Week 6 loss
items.s: Brandon Aubrey did not attempt a field goal while hitting his lone extra point in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6. Aubrey was held without a field-goal attempt for the second time this season as Dallas really struggled to move the ball on offense against Green Bay, especially in the first half. Aubrey has now hit nine of his 12 field goals and added 14 extra points this season. He will look to bounce back against the Eagles in Week 7.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Solid Starting Option for Fantasy Football in Week 6
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey is just a shadow of his former self for fantasy football this season. In Week 5, he scored just 5.0 fantasy points by kicking just one field goal and one extra point, though he made both of his attempt. Dallas' offense was putrid without WR CeeDee Lamb (quad) on the field. He's back, but the Packers have one of the NFL's toughest defenses against the pass. Aubrey saw so few opportunities in Week 5 that it was tough for him to succeed, though. In Week 6, with Lamb back and healthy, the Cowboys should have a much easier time moving the ball down the field and getting into kicking range. items.h: Brandon Aubrey kick for four points in loss
items.s: Brandon Aubrey hit his only PAT and field goal attempts in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday. Aubrey was hindered by a Dallas offense that sputtered badly after their first drive, failing to do much more in the first half before a field goal. After that, the team was in catch-up mode, and Aubrey didn't see the field again. Better days will come for the star kicker.

Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point try in a Week 5 loss to Tampa Bay on Thursday. Aubrey didn't get many opportunities to kick, but he did nail a 41-yard FG just before halftime. The All-Pro kicker is now 9-for-12 on field-goal tries this season, with all of his misses (including two that were blocked) coming from at least 59 yards out. Aubrey is still one of the league's elite kickers, and he figures to continue getting opportunities from very deep considering the strength of his leg.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Good Volume Start Despite Accuracy Issues
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey missed two of his four field goal attempts in a Week 4 win over the Houston Texans. Though he was a ridiculously accurate kicker in his first season in the NFL, he's been markedly less on-point since then. He hovered around 85 percent accuracy in his second and third season as the Cowboys kicker and now sits at just under 73 percent. The Cowboys have a high-powered offense that's gotten them into scoring range with regularity this season, but Aubrey's fall-off is concerning. He managed 10 fantasy points last game and is the 14th ranked kicker by fantasy scoring in the NFL, though. And a Week 5 matchup with a hapless Tampa Bay Buccaneers team could be…

items.h: Brandon Aubrey misses two field goals Sunday
items.s: Brandon Aubrey made 2-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday. Aubrey hit a 39 and 50-yard field goal early. He later had a 62-yarder blocked and missed a 65-yard field goal.
